MO.method: Black-Scholes gamma × open interest × 100 shares × spot² × 1%; calls positive, puts negative as a dealer-position proxy
MO.limitations: Yahoo open interest/IV can be delayed; dealer sign is assumed, zero-DTE intraday changes and customer positioning are not observable
MO.expected_delay: provider dependent; not exchange-certified real time
